pkgmetadata.longdescription: xray-knife is a command-line and web UI for operating Xray and sing-box proxies: aggregating subscription links, measuring throughput/latency, scanning Cloudflare edges for usable IPs, and running an auto-rotating proxy that fails over between multiple upstream configs. This package ships the statically-linked Linux/amd64 or Linux/arm64 binary released by upstream on GitHub. Source is available (MIT, Go) but currently fails to build under Go 1.26+ due to two unrelated upstream bugs in xtls/xray-core's transitive gvisor dependency; switch to a source ebuild once those are resolved upstream.
